task.goal: Ship all 100 packages within 25 minutes with at most 1 mis-sort and nothing damaged.

comparators.label: Code heuristic: pack stations accept all sizes
Random hill-climber at equal budget (29 sim evals)

accepted.rationale: Move pack-B from (0,4) to (3,5), cutting the damaging sort-1->pack-B leg from 15 to 11 cells (at or below L=12, the longest zero-damage route) while keeping pack-B->ship-B at 8 cells. All legs are now at most 12 cells, damage dropped to 0 on all 6 training days, and the average objective fell from 6945.5 to 3345.5. No other stations moved.

rejected.rationale: The only damaged route is sort-1->pack-B (15 cells, 36 fragile damaged). Moving pack-B from (0,4) to (2,4) shortens that leg to 13 cells and keeps pack-B->ship-B short (6 cells), while maintaining Chebyshev separation from all other stations. Pack stations remain zone-dedicated (A/B/C) to eliminate mis-sorts, and all other routes already show zero damage, so this should eliminate damage entirely and keep all 100 packages shipped.
rejected.reason: not the best proposal this generation (train 6945.5)

rejected.rationale: Add a fourth pack station (pack-D) for zone A at (12,12), adjacent to ship-A and close to sort-1, to split the overloaded zone-A pack queue (pack-A utilization 0.80, wait 5674s) and shorten the A outbound leg. This follows [EXT-g3-1] (more pack stations reduce pack queue time) and [VER-g1] (dock-adjacent pack placement cuts damage and cost). The fragile-route damage (sort-1->pack-B, 36 fragile) remains, so the goal check still fails on training days, but this is the best untested idea from our remaining budget.

rejected.rationale: The champion already satisfies the route-fixer constraint: every route shows zero damage, so L=12 (the longest zero-damage leg, recv-1->sort-1) and all legs are at most 12 cells. Moving pack-B from (3,5) to (3,6) shortens the sort-1->pack-B leg from 11 to 10 cells, keeps all legs at 12 or fewer, and preserves the zero-damage, zero-missort result while slightly reducing total conveyor distance.
rejected.reason: train objective 3345.5 not better than champion 3345.5

rejected.rationale: Keep the champion layout unchanged: it already achieves 0 mis-sorts and 0 damaged packages on all training days, so no package travels a damaging route and every package is shipped. Any move risks reintroducing damage (as seen when pack-B was moved) and cannot beat a zero-damage, zero-missort baseline.

Move pack-B from (3,5) to (4,5) to shorten the sort-1->pack-B leg from 11 to 10 cells, reducing fragile package exposure and travel time while keeping all constraints satisfied. This is a small flow improvement that should slightly lower makespan and objective without introducing damage.

lessons.text: Increasing the number of pack stations from 2 to 6 will reduce queue time at pack by distributing orders across more stations, assuming sorter station placement remains constant.
